fields.System.Title: CNT-401 — Variance rate by zone
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want accuracy broken down by area, so that I can find the
part of the warehouse where stock goes wrong.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then I get counts performed, counts with variance, and net and
  • absolute variance per zone.
  • - Given the report, then absolute variance is shown separately from net — offsetting
  • errors are still errors.
  • - Given the report, then it is built from a daily read model, not a live aggregate.
  • - Given a zone far above the rest, then it is visible without manual comparison.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting |
| Tables | accuracy projection, variance |
| Risks | Net variance hiding offsetting errors |
| Tests | integration |
